name: Combos (parlay) RFQ market making
one_line: Answer 400 ms RFQs on multi-leg sports parlays, earn the leg-count-dependent parlay premium, hedge legs on the CLOB; capital locked against max payout.
maturity: Experimental for an outside maker: product live, no non-Polymarket maker or results public; in-house desk reported
requires_ai: no; optional dependence estimation for unusual legs
edge: Parlay overpricing grows with legs (Kalshi: ~3.7% at 7, ~22% at 10)
capital: $10k+; locked against max payout until last leg
opportunity_size: >=20k combo-able sports legs; US launch ~$31M day two (snippet); Kalshi parlays $13.8B in July
expected_results: no public data; guess 1-3% of payout capacity/month with -10% months
competition: Polymarket in-house desk, sportsbook operators, Kalshi desks
flag: none; Last Look abuse capped at 15% rejects
validate: 2 weeks listen-only RFQ logging vs product of leg mids; pass >=5% premium on 5+ legs
top_risk: Correlated same-game legs and tail payouts
solo_fit_reason: Hard 400 ms deadline, capital-heavy per unit of premium, heavy tails and a reported house desk; needs $25k+ payout capacity to diversify.
speed_class: latency-sensitive with a hard 400 ms (US 200 ms) deadline
capacity_ceiling: request flow and same-slate correlation above ~$250k
changes_made: Maturity set to Experimental per critic note (no external maker shown).
Live catalog: >=20,000 sports legs and 131 pending politics/geopolitics legs.
open_doubts: Combo fees not stated in fetched docs.
US $31.4M figure is a search snippet.
